Name: Cauldron
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/buIbPlm.png[/img]﻿
[/b][b][size=5][b][size=5]
[/size][/b][/size][/b][size=3]WAG provides the user the ability to toggle almost everything in the mod, and it does so by using Cauldron. Cauldron provides for you, the player, an all in one easy place to handle all of your configuration settings.

It also does some nifty game logic on the back end but that's not relevant here hehehe.[/size]

[b][size=5][color=#b6d7a8]Access Cauldron via Generic Mod Config Menu to adjust the following:[/color]
[font=Georgia][size=3][i]Hover over the settings with your cursor in GMCM to show a pop up display that gives you more details for
each of these. They are also explained below:[/i][/size][/font][/size][/b][/font][font=Georgia][b][size=5]

[color=#b6d7a8]Global Options[/color][/size][/b][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3]
[b]Enable Wild Food [/b]- Adds crops and forage focused on edible herbs, fruits, nuts etc. Required for Advanced Difficulty Toggle.[b]
Enable Mixed Seeds[/b] - Adds special mixed seeds to be sold by shopkeepers; requires the Item Extensions mod.[b]
Artisan Difficulty Setting[/b] - Choose from Simple or Advanced. Simple is the same as how wine or jelly is handled in the base game; advanced requires multiple inputs to make more valuable, specific items. Requires Wild Food module enabled. Defaults to simple.[b]
Easy Recipes [/b]- Check this box if you want machine recipes to be known immediately. Otherwise player learns recipes from NPC mail. False by default.
[b]Perfection Toggle[/b] - Uncheck this if you do [i]not[/i] want any of the items from this mod to be needed for the game's perfection requirements.
[b]Florist Only Toggle[/b] - WARNING: ENABLE THIS IF YOU JUST WANT FLORIST OR MAKEUP CATEGORIES ONLY. This will cause errors for all food-related WAG categories if enabled.
[b]Forage Category Overrides[/b] - Changes the categories for items like mushrooms, herbs etc. Purely cosmetic. Requires the mod Calcifer.
[b]Vanilla Tweaks Compatibility [/b]- Changes seeds and saplings to match Vanilla Tweaks style.
[b]Machine Color Scheme [/b]- Select a color scheme for artisanal machines; can choose from Classic (default), Cream or Chocolate.
[b]Machine Art Style [/b]- Select a visual style for artisanal machines; can choose from Kitchen(default), Boutique or Market.
[b]Special Orders [/b]- whether to add special orders to the game
[b]Special Order Priority [/b]- whether to add special orders immediately or not until AFTER major base game special orders are completed
[b]Simple Add On[/b] - Setting this to TRUE will add the simple rules in addition to the advanced rules, so that generic versions of items can be made as well as the specific items.

[/size][/font][center][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Baker Items[/b][/size][/color][size=3]
Choose which baker-themed items to add to your game. Currently has breads, cakes, tiny cakes, doughnuts, muffins, cookies, puddings and pies.

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Barista Items[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]
[/b][font=Georgia]Choose which barista-themed items to add to your game.[/font] Currently has coffee, tea, lemonade and smoothies.

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Boutique Items[/b][/size][/color][size=3][font=Georgia]
Choose which boutique-themed items to add to your game.[/font] Currently has perfume, incense, candles, soap, bouquets and makeup.

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Brewer Items[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]
[/b][font=Georgia][font=Georgia]Choose which brewer-themed items to add to your game.[/font] Currently has[/font] ales and meads.

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Confectioner Items[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]
[/b][font=Georgia][font=Georgia]Choose which confectioner-themed items to add to your game.[/font] Currently has[/font] chocolates, fairy floss, gumballs, hard candies, ice cream, ice cream sandwiches, jelly beans, lollipops, marshmallows, milkshakes and popsicles.

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Gourmand Items[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]
[/b][font=Georgia][font=Georgia]Choose which gourmet-themed items to add to your game.[/font] Currently has[/font] jams, pickles, and packaged goods.

[/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][b]Secret Forage Location Options[/b][/size][/color][size=3][b]
[/b]If you would like the secret forage locations to ALWAYS be available, you can change that here.[/size]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5]
[font=Georgia][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][/size][/color][/b][/font][font=Georgia][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5][/size][/color][/b][/font][quote][font=Georgia][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5]What if I am playing with an older version of WAG? Should I update Cauldron?
[/size][/color][/b][/font][/quote][/size][size=4]
[/size][/color][size=4]NO - if you desire to keep the older versions of the WAG mods you must not update Cauldron. [/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=5]

[/size][/color][/b][quote][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=5]Can I change these configuration options at any time?[/size][/color][/b][/quote]
[size=3]Yes with TWO EXCEPTIONS:

1. Disabling wild food mid save [u]will result in some error items[/u], but they are harmless and can be trashed easily. 

2. Once you enable easy recipes you CANNOT DISABLE it - you've learned the recipes and the game can't take them away. So, make that choice before starting the game and stick with it![/size][b]

[size=5]IMPORTANT - DO NOT delete English translation file - it must remain installed even if you are using another translation. Removing it will crash Cauldron.
